_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Snake kei runga i te {width}×{height} taratoha.
Ko koe te kaitīaki o te snake {player_id}. Neke whai mana: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (ki te whai rānei w/s/a/d).
Whāinga: ora roa rawa atu, ki te whai rānei te roa rawa atu me te puna haupū teitei (te whakapumautanga whakautu {max_turns} whakautu).

board.after_moves: Kāwanatanga o te Poari i tēnei wā: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: I mate a Snake {player_id} nā te nekehanga kāore i tika.

outcome.survived_win: I ora te kaitākaro {player_id}; i mate katoa ētahi atu.
outcome.all_dead_simul: I mate katoa ngā nakahi i te wā kotahi.
outcome.outlived: I ora ake te kaitākaro i ētahi atu katoa.
outcome.turn_limit: Kua tae te rohe huri - ko te kaute pai rawa atu e wikitoria ana i te wehenga.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Urutapanga whakamutunga o ngā rōpū (kino ki te pai rawa): {groups}
